title: Outline long Boolean and QF_UF refutations into bounded Lean lemmas
summary: Lemma outlining in the Lean reconstructor now applies to every fragment above 500 proof steps, cuts chains every 500 nested steps, and keeps the propositional slice axiom-free by passing decidability witnesses as parameters. A 7-level QF_UF diamond and pigeonhole-5, which previously exhausted Lean's heartbeat budget, now check in about 3 s each.
